messages:
Ivy (Marketing): quick ask — small benchmark asset bundle for launch: hero diagram (web + print), two webinar slides, 1-pager PDF, four social tiles (square + story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Deadline Tue EOD. Who can take?

Kai (Design): I can. file specs? copy? logos?

Ivy (Marketing): specs: hero web 1400x800, print 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email 600x200. SVG must include element IDs for HubSpot mapping. Copy will be short headlines — I'll add to Drive. Logos only from Legal-approved whitelist.

Rosa (Product): uploaded numbers: p50=39ms, p95=118ms, cost=$0.007/1k tokens. Added README: "measured in internal testbeds; not an SLA."

Mika (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot, include element ids like id=form-email id=seg-webinar id=sfdc-lead. I'll supply mapping CSV after export.

Legal (Legal): compliance note — do not use customer logos without explicit written approval. Use qualifiers such as "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds."

Kai (Design): plan: WIP Mon 09:00 PT for hero + slides, final Tue afternoon. Will export EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE handoff and include SVG with labeled IDs. Will upload to Drive and tag @Ivy.

Ivy (Marketing): great — priority order: hero+slides, routing SVG, 1-pager, then social/email. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
